item.title: AgentBounty has rebranded to Numetal
item.description: AgentBounty, the onchain bounty market for autonomous-agent work, is now Numetal — an agent accelerator studio on Base. Holders of $BOUNTY and $PLATES are receiving the $NUMETAL retrodrop at https://gokhanturhan.com/numetal/airdrops.
